name: training-adoption-planning
description: Plan training materials + adoption measurement for a change / new tool / new process. Learning-needs analysis per audience, content mix (docs / videos / live workshops / office hours / in-product tours / guided learning paths), delivery pipeline (content authoring + review + publishing), adoption metrics (activation / retention / NPS / support tickets avoided), reinforcement (ADKAR R-step), change-champion network, localization + accessibility. Hand-offs to change-impact-assessment + documentation-strategy + communication-plan.
